evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ177. The user delivers an uppercut with the Power Pole and then extends the pole toward the opponent for a second hit. Holding the input after the uppercut charges the follow-up so it deals more damage the longer it is charged; current documentation identifies the move as a two-hit, chargeable Power Pole attack. Existing 50% Ultimate Finish acquisition evidence and conflicting reward-table presentation are preserved.
